if.test: pStartDate != null and pStartDate != '' and pEndDate != null and pEndDate != ''

choose.when: AND ( shopion.tOprQuotRqst.RegistDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND shopion.tOprQuotRqst.RegistDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) )
AND ( QuotDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{pStartDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND QuotDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{pEndDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopion.tOprQuotRqst INNER JOIN shopion.tPrfCust C ON shopion.tOprQuotRqst.RegistId = C.LoginId
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tOprQuotRqst (QuotRqstNo, RqstProdName, RqstProdAttr, CateName, MakerName, ModelName, RqstQty, ProdUnit, CustOrderNo, RqstMemo, AtchFile, QuotState, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate, ChangeId, ChangeName, ChangeDate) VALUES (#{quotRqstNo}, #{rqstProdName}, #{rqstProdAttr}, #{cateName}, #{makerName}, #{modelName}, #{rqstQty}, #{prodUnit}, #{custOrderNo}, #{rqstMemo}, #{atchFile}, #{quotState}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW(), #{changeId}, #{changeName}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE shopion.tOprQuotRqst SET QuotState = #{quotState}, QuotDate = NOW(), ProdCode = #{prodCode}, ProdName = #{prodName}, ProdAttr = #{prodAttr}, SalePrice = #{salePrice}, OrderQty = #{orderQty}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE QuotRqstNo = #{quotRqstNo}
